## Phase 0 deliverables

- Complete original syllabus and canonical folder plan, with an independent completeness fixture.
- Root project documentation, MIT license, attribution, and contribution standards.
- Category navigation, substantive topic planning pages, learning roadmap, glossary, and complexity guidance.
- Python/C++ testing infrastructure, catalog and link validation, and lightweight GitHub Actions CI.
- Structure and configuration validation; actual local execution results are reported in [the Phase 0 review summary](phase-0-review.md).

CI execution on GitHub requires a published repository and a workflow run; this local foundation does not claim a remote CI pass.
